strong.$description:
Emphasis weight for this brand, as a numeric font weight. Open per brand — how strong "strong" is (600 vs 800) is the brand's call, only the role name is fixed.

Used in:
Every text style on this brand's strong weight — headings, emphasized labels, primary button text.

Do not:
Do not use it for running body copy — that is font-weight.default; strong is the emphasis cut.

default.$description:
Regular weight for this brand, as a numeric font weight. Open per brand.

Used in:
Every text style on this brand's default weight — body copy, most labels.

Do not:
Do not use it for emphasis, headings or primary buttons — those take font-weight.strong.

The font.label.lg text styles.

Do not:
Do not bind it directly — apply the text style.

Tracking of the label.md role as a percentage of its font size, the normal ratio. Open per brand, because the right tracking depends on the typeface; fixed across theme and viewport — a percentage follows whatever size the viewport gives the role.

heading.$description:
Typeface for display and heading text. Open per brand; fixed across script and viewport.

Used in:
font.display.sm and every font.heading.* style.

Do not:
Do not use it for paragraphs, labels, captions or micro text — that is font-family.text.

text.$description:
Typeface for running and interface text. Open per brand; fixed across script and viewport. Where a brand picks no text typeface of its own, it repeats the heading one.

Used in:
Every font.body.*, font.label.*, font.caption.* and font.micro.* style except the numeric ones.

Do not:
Do not use it for display or heading text — that is font-family.heading; for digits that must align, use font-family.mono.

sm.$description:
Corner radius of a sm button, the one with height size.md. Varies by brand: this brand's buttons are pills (border-radius.full).

Used in:
A button, icon button, toggle button or segmented control with height size.md.

Do not:
Do not use it on a form field — use border-radius.input.sm.

md.$description:
Corner radius of a md button, the one with height size.lg. Varies by brand: this brand's buttons are pills (border-radius.full).

Used in:
A button, icon button, toggle button or segmented control with height size.lg.

Do not:
Do not use it on a form field — use border-radius.input.md.

lg.$description:
Corner radius of a lg button, the one with height size.xl. Varies by brand: this brand's buttons are pills (border-radius.full).

Used in:
A button, icon button, toggle button or segmented control with height size.xl.

Do not:
Do not use it on a form field — use border-radius.input.lg.

sm.$description:
Corner radius of a sm form field, the one with height size.md. Varies by brand.

Used in:
A text input, select, text area, search field or combobox with height size.md.

Do not:
Do not use it on a button — use border-radius.button.sm.

md.$description:
Corner radius of a md form field, the one with height size.lg. Varies by brand.

Used in:
A text input, select, text area, search field or combobox with height size.lg.

Do not:
Do not use it on a button — use border-radius.button.md.

lg.$description:
Corner radius of a lg form field, the one with height size.xl. Varies by brand.

Used in:
A text input, select, text area, search field or combobox with height size.xl.

Do not:
Do not use it on a button — use border-radius.button.lg.

xs.$description:
Corner radius of a xs container. Varies by brand.

Used in:
A surface the size of a tag or a badge.

Do not:
Do not use it for a pill or a circle — use border-radius.full.

sm.$description:
Corner radius of a sm container. Varies by brand.

Used in:
A surface the size of a chip or a small tooltip. Media or a container nested inside it uses border-radius.container.xs.

Do not:
Do not use it on a container nested inside a sm one — use border-radius.container.xs. For a pill or a circle, use border-radius.full.

md.$description:
Corner radius of a md container. Varies by brand.

Used in:
A surface the size of a card, a menu or a popover. Media or a container nested inside it uses border-radius.container.sm.

Do not:
Do not use it on a container nested inside a md one — use border-radius.container.sm. For a pill or a circle, use border-radius.full.

lg.$description:
Corner radius of a lg container. Varies by brand.

Used in:
A surface the size of a panel or a large card. Media or a container nested inside it uses border-radius.container.md.

Do not:
Do not use it on a container nested inside a lg one — use border-radius.container.md. For a pill or a circle, use border-radius.full.

xl.$description:
Corner radius of a xl container. Varies by brand.

Used in:
A surface the size of a modal or a bottom sheet. Media or a container nested inside it uses border-radius.container.lg.

Do not:
Do not use it on a container nested inside a xl one — use border-radius.container.lg. For a pill or a circle, use border-radius.full.

2xl.$description:
Corner radius of a 2xl container. Varies by brand.

Used in:
A surface the size of a full-screen sheet or hero media. Media or a container nested inside it uses border-radius.container.xl.

Do not:
Do not use it on a container nested inside a 2xl one — use border-radius.container.xl. For a pill or a circle, use border-radius.full.

none.$description:
Square corner. Locked outside the preset system and identical in every brand; fixed across viewport and theme.

Used in:
A single corner that must stay square while the rest of the shape keeps the brand's radius — a tab meeting its panel, a segmented control's inner edges, an image bleeding into a container's edge. Zero as a bound token, so the intent survives a change of preset.

Do not:
Do not square a whole component. A shape that is square on every corner belongs to a brand whose preset is sharp — that is border-radius.button.*, border-radius.input.* or border-radius.container.* resolving to border-radius.sharp.*, not this token repeated four times.

full.$description:
Full pill/circle radius. Locked outside the preset system and identical in every brand; fixed across viewport and theme.

Used in:
Avatars, badges, dots — any shape that must stay fully rounded whatever the brand's preset.

Do not:
Do not use it on inputs or containers — those take their own border-radius.<group>.

xs.$description:
Half-pixel stroke for this brand. Open per brand; fixed across viewport and theme. Figma draws a true half pixel at every zoom, while browsers only render it on 2x screens and above and round it up to a full pixel on 1x, where it looks like border-width.sm.

Used in:
The faintest hairline: a divider or rule that should recede on high-density screens.

Do not:
Do not use it on the outline of a component or anything that must look the same on every screen — that is border-width.sm.

sm.$description:
Hairline stroke for this brand. Open per brand; fixed across viewport and theme.

Used in:
The default outline of a component — button, input, card, chip, tag — and hairline rules: dividers, table rules and separators. One pixel is the resting stroke; a heavier one reads as emphasis, not as a border.

Do not:
Do not carry emphasis with it — a selected or active outline is border-width.md. Focus rings take border-width.focus.

md.$description:
Regular stroke for this brand. Open per brand; fixed across viewport and theme.

Used in:
An outline that has to read as emphasized — the selected or active state of a control, a checked input, a highlighted card. It is a state, not a resting border.

Do not:
Do not use it on the resting outline of a component, which is border-width.sm — reaching here by default doubles every border in the product. Focus rings take border-width.focus, never a brand width.

lg.$description:
Heavy stroke for this brand. Open per brand; fixed across viewport and theme. First-pass default, not audited against real components.

Used in:
Emphasized outlines, selected-state borders and decorative rules.

Do not:
Do not use it on a default component outline — that takes border-width.sm, an emphasized one border-width.md, and a focus ring border-width.focus.

default.$description:
Fill of the brand primary button at rest. Varies by brand; by default it follows color-surface.interactive.brand.strong.default, and with it the theme. A brand that overrides it with a ramp step or a fixed colour keeps that value in both themes.

Used in:
The primary button of the brand sentiment, at rest. Pair with button.color-content.primary for its label and icons, and with button.color-surface.primary.hover for its pointer-over state.

Do not:
Do not use it outside that button — a checkbox, a radio, a danger or neutral primary button or any other solid fill takes its color-surface.interactive.<sentiment>.strong.default.

hover.$description:
Fill of the brand primary button under the pointer. Varies by brand; by default it follows color-surface.interactive.brand.strong.hover, and with it the theme. A brand that overrides it with a ramp step or a fixed colour keeps that value in both themes.

Used in:
The pointer-over state of the primary button of the brand sentiment. Pair with button.color-surface.primary.default at rest and with button.color-content.primary.

Do not:
Do not use it on any other solid hover — that is color-surface.interactive.brand.strong.hover.

primary.$description:
Label and icons on the brand primary button. Varies by brand; by default it follows color-content.static.fixed-white, which keeps 4.5:1 against both default fills in light and dark.

Used in:
The label and icons of the primary button of the brand sentiment. Pair with button.color-surface.primary.default and button.color-surface.primary.hover.

Do not:
Do not use it on any other strong fill — content on a sentiment strong fill is color-content.static.fixed-white.
